Why act now

Three reasons Carrollton roofs fail in their 20s

Shingle Degradation

Most asphalt shingles from 2000–2006 were rated for 20–25 years. Your roof may already be past its rated lifespan — without any visible signs yet.

Insurance Window

Many carriers won't renew — or will raise your premium — on a roof over 20 years old. Replacing now keeps your coverage intact and rates lower.

Georgia Storm Season

West Georgia sees hail, high winds, and heavy rain every spring. A compromised roof hit by a storm is an emergency — inspecting ahead of time gives you options.
